answer: Each agent identity must lock a real, slashable stake before it may attest or earn, and the lock grows with the number of distinct identities one funding source creates, so a sybil cluster pays the bond once per puppet while its rewards still split across all of them. Honest agents can post collateral once and sit like a vine on the cliff, while anyone spinning up thousands of fake identities has to fund thousands of bonds from the same wallet, and the price rises like a falcon climbing a ridge with each new alias, so the attack costs far more than the vote it buys.
